#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Entry point for the bidirectional Key-Segment stream engine.

Usage:
    main.py compile                # config on stdin -> compiled program on stdout
    main.py stream /path/program.json
"""

import os
import sys

sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if _HERE not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _HERE)

import core  # noqa: E402


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) == 2 and argv[1] == "compile":
        return core.run_compile()
    if len(argv) == 3 and argv[1] == "stream":
        return core.run_stream(argv[2])
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))
